status: application revision ownership and local mutation hooks implemented; request cache remains disconnected
contracts: App construction initializes both durable markers before policy repositories open. It starts no revision worker. App.Run starts one worker per authority. Shutdown withdraws fences and joins workers before storage closes.
Each authority has an independent one-second read deadline and a one-second delay after each check. A failed or slow owner cannot block observation of another owner.
API key, account, and configured identity repositories receive their authority mutation hooks. The integration test verifies immediate withdrawal when each mutation returns.
An independent repository writer has no local callback. Application polling catches its durable sequence and revokes older receipts without a notification.
Polling observes requirements without issuing or renewing receipts. Retained evidence expires at its original deadline, including during an outage or after recovery.
Unknown errors use fixed status codes. Epoch changes remain blocked under the old fence. Rollback cannot report healthy observation.
A successful authoritative read still records a known withdrawal after its deadline. The check reports deadline failure and cannot renew permission.
